europe_now.title: EU’s Kallas wants next week’s UK‑EU summit to kick‑start ‘small steps’ to rejoin
europe_now.summary: Kallas said the upcoming UK‑EU summit should launch modest initiatives to begin reintegration steps. These steps aim to lay a foundation for the United Kingdom's potential return to EU frameworks.

sources.headline: EU’s Kallas wants next week’s UK‑EU summit to kick‑start ‘small steps’ to rejoin

europe_now.title: ‘Blind spot’ no longer: Austria targets Russian espionage with new law
europe_now.summary: Austria has introduced a new law targeting Russian espionage. The legislation aims to strengthen national security by addressing previously overlooked threats.

sources.headline: ‘Blind spot’ no longer: Austria targets Russian espionage with new law

top_stories.title: EU commissioner vows to use ‘all relevant tools’ to protect media freedom as Babiš public broadcasting bill alarms MEPs
top_stories.summary: The EU commissioner declared a commitment to employ all suitable tools for protecting media freedom. This pledge follows concerns that the Babiš administration's public broadcasting legislation may threaten those liberties.

sources.headline: EU commissioner vows to use ‘all relevant tools’ to protect media freedom as Babiš public broadcasting bill alarms MEPs

top_stories.title: UK court convicts 2 Iranian men of spying on journalists
top_stories.summary: A UK court convicted two Iranian men for espionage aimed at journalists. The ruling underscores legal measures against foreign attempts to influence press freedom.

sources.headline: UK court convicts 2 Iranian men of spying on journalists
